posts.name: Jeysie
posts.cooked:
Now that he’s unlocked, I’ll say I enjoy using PW Argent just as much as I thought I would. The only real downsides are not being able to play a quickie Sarabande and Alacritous Subdominant being much less useful to play at all (since I often find that if I have one of the H-melody instruments I’m more likely to be using it on Inspiring Supertonic), but I think that’s made up for by getting a free Silver Shadow and being able to stack plays even more nicely with Cadence. I also find myself being willing to use the second power of Cedistic Dissonant more often for card churn.

And the SFX is so gosh darn pretty-sounding, and Guise’s imitation is downright hilarious.

Now I’m looking forward to when we get XTreme Argent and the poor Vocalize VA has to pull out a punk rocker scream.
